text_comparison.method: PDF text extraction with pypdf; comparison of abstracts, principal theorem headings, and proof-section headings.
findings: The deposited and local manuscripts are not byte-identical or text-identical.
Both present the full Nivat statement as Theorem 1.1, the periodic-wedge bound as Theorem 1.2, and selection of a nonperiodic point as Proposition 1.3.
Both describe the wedge, quadratic local observables, pointed-cone support obstruction, factor-box placement, exact rectangle count, and retained boundary disagreement architecture.
The deposited paper is an earlier version with different title, printed date, exposition, bibliography, and some source-theorem numbering.
text_comparison.scope: This comparison identifies shared argument architecture; it does not certify identical proofs or independently validate either informal proof.

interpretation.supported: The Zenodo record and file timestamps, corroborated by DataCite DOI registration, support a public presentation of this argument on 8 September 2026, before the identified parallel GitHub repository was created on 14 September 2026.
interpretation.limits: These facts establish chronology for the identified artifacts. They do not adjudicate priority against every possible earlier public or private work, establish another author's access to or dependence on this paper, or by themselves certify mathematical correctness.
